XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Start&Stop system - Version with colour display

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Start&Stop is a device that automatically stops the engine whenever the vehicle stops, and automatically restarts it as soon as the driver intends to resume driving. This reduces fuel consumption and pollutant emissions.

This system requires batteries with specific technology and technical characteristics , so care must be taken when replacing and maintaining the battery. The battery must have the same characteristics as the battery being replaced.

Start&Stop system indicators:

A - Start&Stop system Active

B - Start&Stop system Active

C - Start&Stop system Deactivated

D - Signal General fault (engine oil pressure sensor, inertia switch, external lights, parking sensors, Start&Stop system)

It is also possible to manually deactivate the system by pressing the appropriate button (E) on the instrument panel. Deactivation is confirmed by the warning light or symbol (C) on the multifunction display

The Start&Stop system is only activated after exceeding a speed of 10 km/h and when the following conditions are met:

Manual gearbox
- Vehicle stationary
- Gearbox in neutral
- Clutch pedal released
- Engine at operating temperature

Automatic gearbox
- Vehicle stationary
- Brake pedal depressed / Gear lever in N position

Confirmation of Start&Stop system activation is indicated by the (A) or (B) warning light coming on in the instrument panel

Following the Start&Stop intervention to restart the engine, it is necessary to:

Manual gearbox
- Press the clutch pedal

Automatic gearbox
- Release the brake pedal / Move the gear lever from the N position to any driving position

The Start&Stop system may fail to operate for one of the following reasons:

- Engine not yet at operating temperature
- Battery not sufficiently charged
- Heated rear window activated
- Windscreen wipers activated at maximum speed
- Particulate filter regeneration in progress
- Driver's door open
- Driver's seatbelt not fastened
- Reverse gear engaged
- If the automatic air conditioning has not yet reached the desired temperature inside the passenger compartment
- Road on a slope
- Very low or very high outside temperature

The system automatically reactivates the engine, regardless of the driver's choice, if one of the following conditions occurs:

- Windscreen wipers activated at maximum speed
- Flat battery
- Vehicle in motion (sloping roads)
- Engine off for more than 3 minutes
- Low brake system pressure

XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: Battery disconnection - Versions with false negative terminal
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
If it is necessary to disconnect the battery, proceed by disconnecting device (1)

Do not disconnect the battery monitoring sensor (2). The sensor should only be disconnected when replacing the battery.

When reconnecting the battery, turn the ignition key to the "STOP" position with the driver's door closed, and wait at least 1 minute for the system to complete initialisation

XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: Battery disconnection - Versions without false negative terminal
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
If it is necessary to disconnect the battery, press the button on the connector (B) to detach the connector.

Do not disconnect the battery monitoring sensor (A). The sensor should only be disconnected when replacing the battery.

When reconnecting the battery, turn the ignition key to the "STOP" position with the driver's door closed, and wait at least 1 minute for the system to complete initialisation

If it is necessary to connect a battery in parallel to perform an emergency start, connect the positive terminal of the auxiliary battery to the positive terminal of the vehicle battery and the negative terminal to any ground point on the engine

Never connect the negative terminal of the auxiliary battery to the negative terminal of the vehicle battery.

XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: Battery recharge - Versions with false negative terminal
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
To recharge the battery, proceed as follows:

- Disconnect the negative terminal using the quick release
- Connect the positive cable of the battery charger to the positive terminal of the vehicle battery
- Connect the negative cable of the battery charger to the false negative terminal of the battery
- Switch on the battery charger
- Once the procedure is complete, remove the battery charger
- Reconnect the negative terminal

XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: Battery recharge - Versions without false negative terminal
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
To recharge the battery, proceed as follows:

- Disconnect the connector from the battery monitoring sensor
- Connect the positive cable of the battery charger to the positive terminal of the vehicle battery
- Connect the negative cable of the battery charger to the negative terminal of the vehicle battery
- Switch on the battery charger
- Once the procedure is complete, remove the battery charger
- Reconnect the connector
